info.title: API.SH: Quora
info.description: The Quora API from API.SH: public Quora data as clean JSON. Every endpoint is a GET with query parameters and your key in the x-api-key header. Calls that run cost the credits shown (x-credits): successes, and lookups that found nothing (404). Refused calls and errors on our side are free. Docs: https://api.sh/docs · Every platform: https://api.sh/openapi.json

get.description:

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/quora-answer

parameters.name: url

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

get.description:
The answers to a Quora question, 10 items per call in Quora's own ranking: text, author, credential, upvotes, views, shares, comments and date. Pass `next_cursor` back as `cursor` to read on; `has_more` is false on the last call. Some items in a call are not answers, so a call can return fewer than 10.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/quora-answers

parameters.name: cursor
parameters.description: The `next_cursor` of the previous call; leave out for the first answers.

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

get.description:
A public Quora profile: name, credential, bio, followers and following, answer, question and post counts, all-time and last-month content views, Top Writer years, work, education and location credentials, publishers, Spaces, and the first items Quora shows logged-out visitors on the profile (the newest posts and answers, or with `tab=answers` the pinned and newest answers, or with `tab=questions` the questions asked) with text, upvotes, views, shares and comments. Logged out, Quora lists only those first items, so `has_more` tells whether the profile has more. Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/quora-user

parameters.name: username
parameters.description: Profile name as in the profile link (quora.com/profile/<name>), or the whole profile link.

parameters.name: tab
parameters.description: Which list to return with the profile: all (newest posts and answers), answers (pinned and newest answers) or questions (the questions the user asked, newest first).

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

apiKey.name: x-api-key
apiKey.description: Create keys at https://app.api.sh/keys. Authorization: Bearer <key> also works.

raw.name: raw
raw.description: 0 leaves out the bulky `raw` source blocks (often 10-30x smaller).

fields.name: fields
fields.description: Comma-separated fields to return, e.g. `posts.id,posts.title`. Call metadata is always included.

fresh.name: fresh
fresh.description: 1 skips the 24-hour cache and fetches live.

output.name: output
output.description: csv or ndjson returns the response's records (its main list, or the object as one row) as CSV or NDJSON instead of JSON.

records.name: records
records.description: With output=csv|ndjson: the top-level list to turn into rows (e.g. `reviews`), or `.` for the whole object as one row.

status_url.description: On a 503 for a paused endpoint: the status page, which lists open incidents.

E400.description: A parameter is missing or invalid. Not charged (unless the call ran and the source rejected the value; credits_used says).

E401.description: Missing, invalid, revoked or expired API key. Not charged. See https://api.sh/docs/errors#401

E402.description: Not enough credits, a spend limit you set was reached (`spend_limit`), or the key's monthly credit cap was reached (`key_cap`). Not charged.

E404.description: Not found, or not public. A lookup that ran costs the endpoint's price (credits_used says); an unknown route is free.

E502.description: The source site failed this time; retry. Not charged.

E503.description: Endpoint paused or temporarily unavailable; may include retry-after, and status_url (https://api.sh/status) for a paused endpoint. Not charged.
